question: 累计消费金额超过全平台用户平均累计消费2倍、且累计下单超过8笔的用户有哪些？（请给出用户名、累计金额、订单数与购买商品种数）
gold_sql: WITH user_stats AS (SELECT o.user_id AS uid, SUM(o.total_amount) AS spent, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS orders, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.product_id) AS sku_cnt FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY o.user_id) SELECT u.username, ROUND(us.spent, 2) AS total_spent, us.orders, us.sku_cnt FROM user_stats us JOIN users u ON u.id = us.uid WHERE us.spent > 2 * (SELECT AVG(spent) FROM (SELECT SUM(total_amount) AS spent FROM orders WHERE status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY user_id) t) AND us.orders > 8 ORDER BY us.spent DESC, u.id
pred_sql: WITH user_stats AS (SELECT o.user_id AS uid, SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_spent, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count FROM orders o WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY o.user_id HAVING COUNT(o.id) > 8), avg_spent AS (SELECT AVG(total_spent) AS avg_total_spent FROM user_stats) SELECT u.username, ROUND(us.total_spent, 2) AS total_spent, us.order_count, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.product_id) AS product_count FROM user_stats us JOIN users u ON u.id = us.uid JOIN orders o ON o.user_id = us.uid AND o.status != 'cancelled' JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE us.total_spent > (SELECT avg_total_spent * 2 FROM avg_spent) GROUP BY u.id ORDER BY total_spent DESC
